biography: Richard Lyons, a name synonymous with flamboyant driving and a touch of British eccentricity, hails from a small village nestled in the Cotswolds. His racing journey began not on asphalt, but on the muddy fields surrounding his family's farm, tearing around on a battered quad bike, much to the chagrin of his neighbors. A chance encounter with a local racing team owner at a village fete ignited a spark, and Lyons soon found himself behind the wheel of a kart. His raw talent was undeniable, but his aggressive style often led to spectacular crashes and equally spectacular comebacks. A defining moment came at the Brands Hatch Indy Circuit in his early Formula Ford days; starting last after a qualifying mishap, he stormed through the field, executing daring overtakes that left spectators breathless, eventually finishing second. Currently a veteran presence within the Aston Martin stable, Lyons is seen as a mentor to younger drivers but is still looking to make his mark at the highest level.
drivingStyle: Lyons is an aggressive, attacking driver, known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to push the limits of adhesion. He favors a high-risk, high-reward approach, often sacrificing tire conservation for outright pace. While his style can be erratic, leading to occasional mistakes, it also allows him to extract maximum performance from the car when conditions are right. He thrives under pressure, often delivering his best performances when the stakes are highest, but can sometimes become overly aggressive in wheel-to-wheel combat.

careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2019, shattering his team's hopes of victory and facing intense media scrutiny.
